title: [observability] A guardrail held out of its healthy range raises one alert in Needs you, and it clears once held back in range
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/alerts.rs (the loop's alert step: `Monitor::check`, `read_databases` and `database_events` as the pattern for a reading on its own interval, `open_keys`, `Event::Fire` and `Event::Clear`), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve.rs's core-lines module (objective 084: the figures, the ranges file, the states) and serve/storage.rs (`report`).

This comes after objective 084 (the Core lines frame), which must be in the tree. If 086–088 are in, their figures alert like the rest.

The problem (owner, 2026-11-12 13:30; sync/roadmap-effects.md, "Showing and alerting"; sync/notes-guardrails-rev-e.md, "One general point"). The Core lines card says which figures are out of their range, but only to someone looking at it. The owner asked for one alert kind, "guardrail out of range", that names the line, the figure, its value and its range, is raised once, is shown in Needs you, and clears by itself. A range set within about 5% of today's value (gate time, first pass, dollars per landing) would raise and clear every hour. That flapping would make Needs you wrong, and Needs you being right is the observability north star. So a figure must stay out for a while before it raises, and stay back in for a while before it clears.

Required behaviour.
(a) The loop's alert step reads the Core lines figures every `SPAWN_ALERT_GUARDRAIL_SECS` (default 300). They are the same figures `GET /api/core-lines` gives, computed by the same code, with the ranges file read at each reading. Moving that code where both serve and the alert step can call it is part of the work.
(b) A figure whose state has been `out` at every reading for `SPAWN_GUARDRAIL_RAISE_SECS` (default 7200) opens one `guardrail_out_of_range` alert:
- subject: "guardrail <key>";
- key: guardrail_out_of_range:<key>:<out_since_ms>;
- evidence: {line, key, name, value, range, out_since_ms (its first reading out of this stretch), reading_ms};
- text: names the line, the figure's name, its value and its range. The card's words are welcome.
There is one open alert per figure. A figure in range, without a range or without a value opens nothing, and a reading that is not `out` restarts the count.
(c) An open alert clears once its figure has not been `out` at any reading for `SPAWN_GUARDRAIL_CLEAR_SECS` (default 3600). Its cleared evidence is that reading: {key, state, value, range, reading_ms}. A reading `out` again in that time restarts the count.
(d) The hysteresis may be kept in the loop's memory: a restarted loop counts again from its first reading. The alert shows in Needs you as any open alert does. Read off a screenshot.
Nothing but the alert step and `spawn serve` reads the ranges file. No gate, integrator or deploy step reads the figures or the alert.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/089.sh. A real `spawn loop` and `spawn serve` run on a scratch database, with the alert step reading every 2 s, the guardrails every second, raise after 6 s and clear after 6 s. The ranges file at <workspace root>/core-lines.json sets free disk at least 10^18 bytes (out from the first reading) and the database against its log at most 10^12 (in). Checks:
- (1) Through `GET /api/alerts`, within 60 s:
  - free disk has one open `guardrail_out_of_range` alert with its evidence;
  - fired_at_ms is at least 6 s after its out_since_ms, which is a reading of this loop;
  - its text names the line and "Free disk";
  - there is no alert for the database ratio, and no other guardrail alert.
- (2) Free disk's range is then moved to 1 byte or more. Within 60 s the alert is cleared, at least 6 s after the move, and its cleared evidence is {key, state "in", range {"min":1}}.
It fails with 1 on f41cbcc1: there is no such alert. Its throwaway stacks 084's throwaway (sync/obj-089/throwaway.diff).

The product reason. Ranges matter only if someone hears when a figure leaves them, and the owner reads Needs you, not every card. The hold times keep a near-limit figure from becoming a new item every hour. Monitoring only.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (074, 084 and 057 among them) and add tests of your own for the new behaviour: alert-step unit tests of the raise hold, a reading in range restarting it, one open per figure, the clear hold and a reading out restarting it, and of no alert for a figure without a range or a value.
